purpose: Additive historical provenance fields for issued Betting Edge report payloads. These fields document how a report was produced and must not alter recommendation logic.

fields.contractBlobSha: git blob SHA or null if unavailable
fields.runnerBlobSha: git blob SHA or null if unavailable
fields.feedGeneratedAt: exact data/live-odds.json generatedAt used for issuance
fields.feedBlobSha: git blob SHA of data/live-odds.json used for issuance or null if unavailable
fields.researchLibraryBlobSha: git blob SHA of canonical research-library.json

fields.grade: A|B|C|D|NR with optional +/- only for communication
fields.limitation: strongest caveat, conflict, era issue or research gap
fields.text: concise display History Fit wording derived from this structured record

failureBehavior.researchUnavailable: Use HISTORY LIBRARY UNAVAILABLE/NR-style disclosure as appropriate; do not fabricate retrieved prior IDs.
failureBehavior.historySaveFailure: Deliver the already-validated report and surface HISTORY SAVE FAILED; do not rebuild or mutate the report solely for storage.
